criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 23 October 2027 (18 months after the 23 April 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies the threatened $3,400,000 claim by Calloway Marine Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $29,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $29,300,000 is wrong.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($30,000,000 - $350,000 = $29,650,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (23 October 2027), with days remaining from 2 February 2026 (628 days).
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
